evidence.label: Creality Falcon A1 Pro rated speed
evidence.note: Creality lists the Falcon A1 Pro at 600 mm/s maximum working speed (36000 mm/min); its consumable parameter guide recommends material speeds up to 10000 mm/min. Two published A1 Pro $$ reads give $110=$111=36000 and $120=$121=1000, limits per motor on its CoreXY. Sources: https://www.creality.com/products/falcon-a1-pro-20w, https://wiki.creality.com/en/laser-engraver/falcon-a1-pro/consumable-parameter-guide, https://github.com/barebaric/rayforge/pull/461, https://forum.lightburnsoftware.com/t/several-errors-in-the-same-work-creality-falcon-a1-pro/177926

evidence.label: Creality Falcon A1 Pro manufacturer configuration
evidence.note: Creality LightBurn bundle checked 2026-09-19: Width 358, Height 268, S scale 1000, baud 115200, M8 air, autofocus $HZ1, Home macro $HX then $HY, no $J jogging or settings fetch. Vendor labels the connection GRBL-LPC. Two published A1 Pro reads (rayforge PR #461, 2026-09; LightBurn forum topic 177926 post 3, 2025-08) show a grblHAL build by Creality: banner GrblHAL 1.1f, [VER:1.1f.20231005:], [Firmware:Version v1.0.4] with builds 20260706154934 and 20250618205542, [FIRMWARE:grblHAL], [BOARD:A1 Pro Laser Master], [KINEMATICS:CoreXY v2.02]; $22=43 (homing on), $23=3, $30=1000, $32=1, $62=0, $130=363 and $131=273 (the 358 x 268 area plus the 5 mm $27 pull-off). KerfDesk reads $$ at connect and writes no setting (ADR-322 Amendment 3). The A1 Pro of the KerfDesk maintainer has not been read. The retained grblHAL family selection uses model-specific command overrides; it is not hardware qualification. A live 2026-07-19 status report from a maintainer A1 Pro read Bf:512,65535 (512 planner blocks and 65535 receive-buffer bytes free; informal, not qualification), so the profile requests the grblHAL 1024-byte streaming window; Start bounds it by the controller-reported capacity (ADR-331). Source: https://wiki.creality.com/en/laser-engraver/falcon-a1-pro/lightburn-guide

evidence.label: Creality Falcon A1 Pro laser modules
evidence.note: The 20 W blue module (455 nm, 0.08 x 0.1 mm spot) ships fitted; the optional 2 W infrared module (1064 nm, 0.03 mm spot) swaps with it on the same carriage, so one is fitted at a time. Pick the fitted one under Laser module. Sources: https://www.crealityfalcon.com/products/falcon-a1-pro-20w-dual-laser-engraver, https://www.tomshardware.com/maker-stem/creality-falcon-a1-pro-20-watt-review. Not measured on a machine.
